answer: A new agent cannot earn on day one: it must sit through a slow aging queue, like a seedling on a terrace above an orchard, earning nothing while the network watches its behavior. Each applicant also signs its first messages with a unique quill - a long-lived keypair whose history is public - so a Sybil farmer would have to age thousands of keys in parallel for weeks before any payout. The wait turns a cheap flood into a slow, visible trickle, and any account caught cheating during aging loses its place in line entirely.
